## 25 Things to Do in Cappadocia — The Full List

Cappadocia offers 25+ activities beyond the hot air balloon: ATV, jeep and horse tours, full-day Red and Green tours, underground cities, open-air museums, hamam and a Turkish night. Trip and Tick prices start at €25 (ATV or jeep) and €100 (balloon). Below, each activity says what it involves and what to know before you go.

## 1. Hot Air Balloon Ride (from €100)

Cappadocia's signature experience: a sunrise flight over the fairy chimneys. Two options: Standard from €100 per person, Romantic Private on request via WhatsApp. Children aged 7-12 pay 80% of the adult price; children under 6 are not permitted, and pregnant guests cannot fly. Booking: [/balonlar](/en/balloon-tours).

## 2. ATV (Quad) Tour (from €25)

A guided ATV tour through the valleys around Göreme, with routes such as Red Valley and Love Valley depending on the day. Standard tour from €25, sunrise or sunset version from €35. Details: [/aktiviteler](/en/activities).

## 3. Horseback Riding (from €35)

The name Cappadocia is often linked to an ancient Persian name read as "land of beautiful horses", and riding is the region's traditional activity. Rides start from €35. The valley trails are a favourite for couples at sunset.

## 4. Jeep Safari (4x4) (from €25)

An off-road tour to hidden valleys and lesser-known fairy chimney clusters. Standard tour from €25, sunrise or sunset version from €30. Works well for families and groups because everyone rides seated.

## 5. Red Tour — from €50

The classic full-day guided tour of the Göreme area. Typical stops are the Göreme Open Air Museum, Uçhisar Castle, Paşabağı, Devrent Valley, a pottery workshop in Avanos, Üç Güzeller and a panorama point. Stops can vary by day, so confirm the programme when you book.

## 6. Green Tour — from €50

A full-day tour heading south: the Ihlara Valley walk, Selime Monastery, an underground city and a Pigeon Valley panorama. Suits guests who enjoy walking and stairs. Confirm the exact programme when you book.

## 7. Sunset Viewing — Esentepe / Uçhisar / Paşabağı (Free)

Cappadocia's golden light is best watched from three points: **Esentepe**, a short walk from Göreme and the best known; **Uçhisar Castle**, with a wide panorama over the valleys; and **Paşabağı**, among the mushroom-shaped chimneys. Trip and Tick's guided sunset tour starts from €30.

## 8. Underground City Exploration — Derinkuyu and Kaymaklı

The two best-known underground cities are open to visitors every day from 08:00 to 17:00, and the Ministry of Culture and Tourism lists entry at €13 each at the time of writing. **Derinkuyu** was opened to the public in 1965, and only about ten percent of it can be visited today. **Kaymaklı** has four floors unearthed, with the spaces gathered around the ventilation shafts. Wear closed shoes and bring a sweater: it is cool and the passages are narrow.

## 9. Cave Hotel Stay (price on request)

An experience in itself: sleeping inside the tuff rock and watching the balloons from a cave terrace. Hotel and package prices are on request: send the dates and the village you prefer on WhatsApp. You can browse stays on the [/oteller](/en/hotels) page.

## 10. Turkish Bath (Hamam) (from €50)

A traditional hamam session to rest after a full day of walking or a sunrise start. Trip and Tick's hamam experience starts from €50, and the deluxe version from €75.

## 11. Wine Tasting (Avanos / Ürgüp)

Cappadocia is a long-established wine region, and tastings in Avanos and Ürgüp are an easy half-day addition. Opening hours and tasting formats vary by winery, so ask for current availability. Autumn, around the harvest, is a pleasant time to go. Price on request.

## 12. Photo Tour (With a Professional)

A morning or evening session with a photographer: sunrise shots with balloons in the background, then portraits among the fairy chimneys. A popular choice for couples and honeymooners. Price on request via WhatsApp.

## 13. Microlight Flight (from €95)

For a different aerial view, a microlight flight over the valleys starts from €95 per person, and the deluxe version from €175. Like the balloon, it depends on weather.

## 14. Troglodyte Villages Walk — Çavuşin / Ortahisar / Mustafapaşa (Free)

"Troglodyte" means a person living in rock-carved homes, and these villages still show rock dwellings. Ortahisar has a large rock castle, and Mustafapaşa, formerly known as Sinasos, has old stone houses and churches. A walk plus a coffee break fills half a day.

## 15. Fairy Chimney Observation Points — Paşabağı, Devrent, Üç Güzeller (Free)

- **Paşabağı**: multi-headed fairy chimneys and a rock-cut hermit cell
- **Devrent (Imagination Valley)**: rocks that look like animals
- **Üç Güzeller (Three Beauties)**: at the entrance of Ürgüp, mushroom-capped chimneys and a well-known silhouette

All three are usually included in the Red Tour.

## 16. Ihlara Valley Hike

A canyon in Aksaray province with Byzantine-era rock churches along its walls. The usual walk runs from Selime towards Belisırma, with restaurants along the river. Wear proper walking shoes.

## 17. Selime Monastery

A large rock-carved monastery complex at the northern end of Ihlara Valley. The stairs are steep, so wear shoes with good grip. It is usually included in the Green Tour.

## 18. Göreme Open Air Museum (€20 entry)

Göreme National Park and the Rock Sites of Cappadocia were inscribed on the UNESCO World Heritage List in 1985, and the Göreme Archaeological Site opened as a museum in 1967. The Ministry of Culture and Tourism lists it as open every day from 08:00 to 17:00 (box office closes 16:15) at €20, with an audio guide service. The site holds rock-cut churches and monastery rooms, so allow a couple of hours.

## 19. Uçhisar Castle

A large natural rock used as a fortification, and one of the highest viewpoints in the region. From the top you can see Pigeon Valley, Love Valley and Göreme. Sunrise and sunset are the best times. Check the current entry fee at the gate.

## 20. Paşabağı — Multi-Headed Fairy Chimneys (Free)

One of Cappadocia's most photographed fairy chimney groups, with giant mushroom-capped rocks and a hermit cell associated with St. Simeon. A short visit; it is included in the Red Tour.

## 21. Devrent (Imagination) Valley (Free)

The rocks here look like animals, and shapes such as camels are often pointed out. The forms look different depending on the season and daylight. A fun game for children in the family.

## 22. Carpet and Kilim Workshop Visit

Traditional carpet workshops between Avanos and Ürgüp let you watch weaving and see finished pieces. Visiting is free and buying is optional.

## 23. Ceramic (Pottery) Workshop — Avanos

Avanos is known for pottery shaped from the clay of the Kızılırmak river, and many workshops let you try the wheel. Visiting is free and buying is optional.

## 24. Anatolian Cuisine — Testi Kebab and More

Cappadocia's signature dish is **testi kebab**, meat cooked in a sealed clay pot that is broken open at the table. Mantı with yogurt and regional wines are common companions. Trip and Tick's Turkish night evening starts from €30.

## 25. Valley Walks and Sunrise Viewpoints (Free)

Rose, Red, Love and Pigeon valleys are popular walking areas. Start early, when the light is soft and the paths are quieter. Wear closed shoes.

## Booking Activities with Trip and Tick

All activity bookings can be made from the [/aktiviteler](/en/activities) page. Combination packages (for example balloon plus ATV plus dinner) are priced on request on the [/paketler](/en/packages) page.

## Activity Combination Suggestions — 3-Day Plan

**Day 1**: Balloon ride (morning) → Breakfast at the hotel → Göreme Open Air Museum → Esentepe sunset → Testi kebab dinner

**Day 2**: Green Tour — Ihlara Valley, Selime and an underground city (full day) → Avanos ceramic workshop → Wine tasting

**Day 3**: ATV sunrise tour → Hotel breakfast → Uçhisar Castle → Paşabağı → Devrent → Üç Güzeller → Carpet workshop → Hamam

## Activity Budget (Per Person)

- Budget 3 days (balloon + 1 tour + museums + food): price on request, ask on WhatsApp
- Mid-range 3 days (balloon + 2 tours + ATV + restaurants): price on request, ask on WhatsApp
- Luxury 3 days (balloon + private jeep + romantic package + photo tour): price on request, ask on WhatsApp

## FAQ — Activity Questions

### How many activities can fit in one day in Cappadocia?
Three to four are possible: a sunrise balloon flight, a Red or Green tour during the day, sunset viewing in the late afternoon and a Turkish night in the evening.

### What are the best activities for children?
Devrent Valley (animal-shaped rocks), the Göreme Open Air Museum, a mini pot at a pottery workshop and a jeep safari work well. Underground cities have narrow passages, so judge by your child's comfort.

### Which activities can be done in the rain?
Underground cities, cave restaurants, carpet and ceramic workshops, museums and hamam. Balloons are cancelled in unsafe weather, and ATV tours may also be.

### Is there nightlife in Cappadocia?
Mostly quiet. Göreme and Ürgüp have restaurants, bars and wine houses, and a Turkish night is the most common evening activity.

### Which activities are suitable for people with limited mobility?
It varies. Many sites have steep stairs or uneven ground, while a jeep safari is seated and workshop visits are simple. Ask Trip and Tick at info@tripandtick.com before booking.

### How many days should the whole Cappadocia trip take?
At least 2 nights (3 days) for a balloon, one tour and a museum. 3 nights (4 days) fits all major activities, and 5+ days lets you add Ihlara and valley hikes.

### Can a wine tasting and balloon ride be done on the same day?
Yes. The balloon is a morning activity and tastings are usually in the afternoon, so it is a busy but compatible combination.

### Which activity is most romantic for honeymoon couples?
A Romantic Private balloon flight (price on request) combined with a cave hotel and a photo tour. Package prices are on request via WhatsApp.

### Can activities be booked online?
Yes, on the [/aktiviteler](/en/activities) page, or send us a WhatsApp message.

### In which languages are activities conducted?
Language options depend on the activity and date. Ask on WhatsApp when you book.
